title: OpenSessionParams
description: open_session parameters; omitted serial settings default to 115200 8N1.

data_bits.description: Data bits: five, six, seven or eight.

flow_control.description: Flow control: none, software or hardware.

parity.description: Parity: none, odd, even, mark or space.

path.description: Physical port path (/dev/ttyUSB0 or COM3) or virtual URI (virtual://echo).

read_timeout_ms.description: Read timeout in milliseconds, default 10, maximum 1000.

record_keep_segments.description: Older text segments to retain. Omit to keep all session history.

record_rx_to.description: Create a new raw receive-stream file on connection (TX bytes are not included).

record_to.description: Record to one .log file containing traffic and annotations. Legacy .txt and JSONL paths remain supported.

stop_bits.description: Stop bits: one, one_point_five or two. one_point_five requires five data bits.
